title: Berlayar Rise — 5 km surroundings reference and 3D detail specification
modellingRules: Do not invent building elevations, exact façade appearance, future road alignment or completed development status.
Measure each future coordinate and distance using authoritative GIS before adding an object to its final 3D position.
Keep forecast or future land uses opt-in and visually differentiated from existing buildings.
Preserve close-up HDB floor/stack alignment, window outlook, highway structure, and sun simulation.
Defer imagery reuse until license/attribution is checked; do not hotlink satellite imagery without permission.
Use lazy loading / chunking, camera distance LOD and frustum culling; prefer <3000 visible draw calls on capable desktop and substantially less on mobile.
For old and new maps maintain geodetic longitude/latitude to site pixel mapping in one module; never visually tune place coordinates independently.
